approved_sentence: The capital-flow thesis should be written as a chain from capital source to vehicle to company to asset or backlog to output to cash or return to durability.
boundary: The full chain is proven only in pieces.
forbidden_sentence: The full capital-flow chain is already proven across all sectors and companies.
use_conditions: Use as method framing, not as an empirical completion claim.
contrary_role_check: Check whether any sentence skips source, use, output, cash, durability, or denominator controls.
next_proof: Company-role taxonomy and full 519-company extraction template.

approved_sentence: Ares and other alternative managers are large credit-routing platforms with measurable AUM, direct-lending AUM, deployment, and borrower examples.
boundary: Platform scale does not allocate dollars to a named borrower without vehicle and borrower bridges.
forbidden_sentence: Private credit is broadly replacing banks across lending markets.
use_conditions: Use only for scale and routing language, not borrower allocation or bank-displacement language.
contrary_role_check: Check bank denominator trends and post-close bank roles before any replacement claim.

approved_sentence: Private credit reaches named borrowers in identifiable industries, and the Ares borrower holder-expansion now normalizes 83 holder/source-taxonomized rows plus a 9-row same-period borrower control.
boundary: Holder rows are partial slices and are not total borrower debt unless reconciled to facility documents.
forbidden_sentence: Visible BDC fair value equals total borrower debt or total facility size.
use_conditions: Use borrower-holder numbers only with period, row type, source channel, and rollup controls.
contrary_role_check: Check whether rows are same-period, duplicated, comparative, transaction-only, or derived summaries.

approved_sentence: Specific borrower-level bank-facility takeout can be proven in selected cases, while broad bank replacement remains unproven.
boundary: Banks may remain as agents, revolver lenders, hedging providers, treasury providers, custody banks, or collateral-facility lenders.
forbidden_sentence: Banks are disappearing from corporate lending.
use_conditions: Use only for selected borrower cases where prior facility status and new financing role are documented.
contrary_role_check: Check post-close bank roles and lane-matched bank-credit denominators.
next_proof: Bank-replacement pattern proof and bank/private-credit lane share pass.

approved_sentence: Insurance and retirement-linked platforms are visible credit-supply channels, but borrower-level and statutory-quality linkage remains incomplete.
evidence_route: capital-flow-current-answer-brief-pass-1.md; capital-flow-promoted-claims-and-overclaims-pass-1.md; Apollo/Athene and KKR/Global Atlantic platform rows in the evidence ledger
boundary: Statutory asset quality, NAIC designations, capital treatment, and borrower destination links remain incomplete.
forbidden_sentence: All insurance assets are private credit or all insurance risk has moved outside banks.
use_conditions: Use only as internal research framing until statutory evidence is extracted.
contrary_role_check: Check whether assets are public IG, affiliated, structured, impaired, or capital-intensive before making quality claims.

approved_sentence: Some large-load and power-demand evidence has moved into tariffs, ESAs, dockets, and utility planning processes.
boundary: Approval, construction, recovery, MW, customer risk, and in-service status vary by jurisdiction and project.
forbidden_sentence: AI demand has already created fully funded in-service power assets everywhere.
use_conditions: Use only where docket, tariff, ESA, or utility-plan evidence is named.
contrary_role_check: Check whether load is speculative, cancellable, unapproved, unrecovered, or not yet in service.

approved_sentence: Utilities can fund approved assets with debt and equity and recover costs from customers when regulators authorize rate-base or rider treatment.
evidence_route: capital-flow-power-grid-claim-dashboard.md; utility docket and denominator maps in the evidence ledger
boundary: Recoverability depends on jurisdiction, order, allowed ROE, capital structure, rider mechanics, lag, and disallowance risk.
forbidden_sentence: Every utility capex dollar is recoverable at attractive returns.
use_conditions: Use only with jurisdiction and recovery mechanism attached.
contrary_role_check: Check for disallowance, lower ROE, lag, denial, customer affordability limits, and prudence review.

approved_sentence: ET and Cheniere show source-backed evidence of energy infrastructure funding capacity and physical output, with Cheniere providing the strongest cargo/entity-debt bridge; full project-level source-of-funds and return proof remain open.
boundary: Named-project cost, financing source, use allocation, customer economics, debt service, waterfall, and return remain open.
forbidden_sentence: ET and Cheniere project returns and source-of-funds are fully proven.
use_conditions: Use only as company/entity/physical-output evidence, not project-and-cash-grade proof.
contrary_role_check: Check whether output can be attributed to a named project and whether funding ties to that project.
next_proof: Named-project source-use-return registry for ET and Cheniere.

approved_sentence: United Rentals is a repeated-period fleet capital-to-output proxy case with visible rental revenue, fleet productivity, OEC growth, cash coverage, collateral proxies, and Yak acquisition funding-chain evidence.
evidence_route: capital-flow-operating-conversion-scorecard-pass-1.md; URI ABL/AR/Yak artifacts listed in the evidence ledger
boundary: True fleet ROIC, true utilization, legal borrowing-base availability, growth-versus-replacement capex, and source-to-purchase allocation remain unproven.
forbidden_sentence: All URI fleet capex is high-return growth capex or fully collateral-protected funding.
use_conditions: Use as proxy-grade operating conversion, not asset-level ROIC or collateral certificate proof.
contrary_role_check: Check replacement capex, utilization, eligible collateral, reserve, advance-rate, and source-to-purchase gaps.
next_proof: URI fleet utilization, category economics, borrowing-base certificate, and purchase allocation passes.

approved_sentence: Sterling is a conversion-supported customer-project execution and acquisition platform whose funding need is timing, retainage, bonding and L/C support, working capital, capex, acquisitions, and backlog conversion.
boundary: Project-owner source-of-funds, actual post-reset L/C usage, bonded backlog, formal covenant cushion, project margin, cancellation economics, and source-to-project credit allocation remain missing.
forbidden_sentence: Sterling's entire backlog is fully customer-funded, non-cancellable, organic, high-margin, and risk-free.
use_conditions: Use as company-level backlog/cash/funding-wrapper mechanism, not project-source proof.
contrary_role_check: Check acquired backlog, unsigned awards, L/C usage, surety usage, margin, and cancellation data.
next_proof: Sterling project/customer funding and post-reset L/C usage bridge.

approved_sentence: Funding wrappers appear to follow the asset being financed: corporate platforms, contracted LNG entities, reusable collateral pools, backlog platforms, and regulated assets use different evidence and financing tests.
boundary: This is pattern language, not yet a fully proven taxonomy for every company or project.
forbidden_sentence: Funding type is proven for every company or every project.
use_conditions: Use as a working model with examples, not a universal rule.
contrary_role_check: Check whether collateral, legal separability, contracted cash flow, or recovery mechanism actually matches the wrapper.
next_proof: More companies classified by wrapper and proof level.

approved_sentence: Some lanes show real operating conversion: URI has repeated-period fleet proxies, Sterling has backlog/cash conversion support, and Cheniere cargoes reconcile to DOE terminal rows, while many lanes still need source-to-output linkage.
boundary: Capex, backlog, AUM, revolver size, L/C capacity, and cargo counts are not full project-return proof by themselves.
forbidden_sentence: Every capex, backlog, revolver, L/C capacity, or AUM number represents productive real-economy investment.
use_conditions: Use only where output metric, period, and boundary are stated.
contrary_role_check: Check maintenance capex, unfunded backlog, utilization, cash reversal, and attribution gaps.

approved_sentence: Outside denominators are necessary before company evidence becomes a market-scale claim.
boundary: Current denominator evidence is uneven by lane and not yet comprehensive.
forbidden_sentence: A few company examples prove a market-wide capital shift.
use_conditions: Use as a control principle unless a specific denominator is named and measured.
contrary_role_check: Check whether outside data contradicts company examples or makes them immaterial.

approved_sentence: Many findings are still snapshots, but URI and Sterling now have repeated-period operating-conversion evidence at proxy grade.
boundary: Most lanes still need eight-quarter or multi-year repeated evidence.
forbidden_sentence: A single quarter proves a durable capital-flow thesis.
use_conditions: Use trend language only for rows with repeated-period support.
contrary_role_check: Check reversal, one-time acquisition effects, utilization decline, cash timing reversal, and missing source-to-output linkage.

approved_sentence: The 519-company universe now has a role/wrapper/proof extraction template that routes every company into a lane, expected funding wrapper, source-availability status, proof level, denominator need, next-document target, safe claim, and do-not-claim boundary.
boundary: Most rows remain radar, high-signal backlog, or lane-queue status until primary-source extraction is run.
forbidden_sentence: The 519-company universe is source-proven or representative of the final thesis.
use_conditions: Use externally only as process coverage, not as completed empirical coverage.
contrary_role_check: Check whether each row is still template-grade or has been upgraded by primary-source extraction.
next_proof: Lane-specific extraction batches from the all-company template.
